name: leap_land_heavy
for: boss slam / dive landing (the same leaps landing; also heavy overhead slams like the Construct's)
notes: A heavy landing about 3.5 m across: debris burst with a 2-frame hit-stop at the impact, a central dust burst, dust clouds rolling out to both sides, five dark cracks racing out on the ground, rocks thrown up that bounce and settle, grit. 15 frames @ 12 fps (1.25 s).
